description: Validates that credential comparisons use constant-time algorithms

rules.title: Constant-time credential comparison
rules.description: All credential, token, and secret comparisons MUST use crypto.timingSafeEqual() with SHA-256 hashing to prevent timing side-channel attacks. Never use !== or === for credential comparison.
rules.validationQuery: crypto.timingSafeEqual used for all credential comparisons

rules.title: No early rejection on credential length
rules.description: Credential comparison must not reject based on length before performing the constant-time comparison. Hash to fixed-length buffers first.
rules.validationQuery: No length-based early return in credential comparison functions
